tool_definitions_source_ck.name: tool_definitions_source_ck
tool_definitions_source_ck.value:
("tool_definitions"."source" = 'builtin' and "tool_definitions"."builtin" is not null and "tool_definitions"."mcp_server_id" is null)
        or ("tool_definitions"."source" = 'mcp' and "tool_definitions"."mcp_server_id" is not null and "tool_definitions"."remote_name" is not null)
        or ("tool_definitions"."source" = 'http' and "tool_definitions"."builtin" is null and "tool_definitions"."mcp_server_id" is null)

tool_definitions_limits_ck.name: tool_definitions_limits_ck
tool_definitions_limits_ck.value: "tool_definitions"."timeout_ms" between 1000 and 60000 and "tool_definitions"."max_output_bytes" between 256 and 262144 and "tool_definitions"."revision" > 0

conversation_controls_human_owner_ck.name: conversation_controls_human_owner_ck
conversation_controls_human_owner_ck.value: "conversation_controls"."owner_mode" <> 'HUMAN_ACTIVE' or "conversation_controls"."owner_staff_id" is not null or "conversation_controls"."owner_external_user_id" is not null

invoices_lifecycle_ck.name: invoices_lifecycle_ck
invoices_lifecycle_ck.value:
("invoices"."status" in ('issued', 'paid')) <= ("invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."due_at" is not null)
        and ("invoices"."status" = 'paid') = ("invoices"."paid_at" is not null)
        and ("invoices"."status" = 'void') = ("invoices"."voided_at" is not null)

tenant_entitlements_plan_ck.name: tenant_entitlements_plan_ck
tenant_entitlements_plan_ck.value:
("tenant_entitlements"."plan_key" is null) = ("tenant_entitlements"."plan_name" is null)
        and ("tenant_entitlements"."plan_key" is null) = ("tenant_entitlements"."currency" is null)
        and ("tenant_entitlements"."plan_key" is null) = ("tenant_entitlements"."price_minor" is null)

purchase_intents_approval_ck.name: purchase_intents_approval_ck
purchase_intents_approval_ck.value: "purchase_intents"."approved_at" is null or ("purchase_intents"."approved_hash" is not null and "purchase_intents"."approval_nonce" is not null)

decision_rubrics_published_ck.name: decision_rubrics_published_ck
decision_rubrics_published_ck.value: "decision_rubrics"."state" = 'draft' or ("decision_rubrics"."config_hash" is not null and "decision_rubrics"."published_at" is not null)

brand_identity_keys_material_ck.name: brand_identity_keys_material_ck
brand_identity_keys_material_ck.value: ("brand_identity_keys"."alg" = 'HS256' and "brand_identity_keys"."secret_id" is not null) or ("brand_identity_keys"."alg" <> 'HS256' and "brand_identity_keys"."public_jwk" is not null)

support_grants_active_idx.name: support_grants_active_idx
support_grants_active_idx.where: "support_grants"."status" = 'approved' and "support_grants"."revoked_at" is null and "support_grants"."ended_at" is null

platform_request.name: platform_request
platform_request.withCheck: "support_grants"."status" = 'pending' and "support_grants"."approved_by" is null and "support_grants"."declined_by" is null and "support_grants"."revoked_at" is null and "support_grants"."ended_at" is null

support_grants_decision_ck.name: support_grants_decision_ck
support_grants_decision_ck.value:
("support_grants"."status" = 'approved') = ("support_grants"."approved_by" is not null)
        and ("support_grants"."status" = 'declined') = ("support_grants"."declined_by" is not null)
        and ("support_grants"."status" = 'pending') = ("support_grants"."decided_at" is null)

conversation_inbox_state_ticket_ck.name: conversation_inbox_state_ticket_ck
conversation_inbox_state_ticket_ck.value: ("conversation_inbox_state"."ticket_number" is null and "conversation_inbox_state"."ticket_source" is null and "conversation_inbox_state"."ticket_opened_at" is null) or ("conversation_inbox_state"."ticket_number" > 0 and "conversation_inbox_state"."ticket_source" in ('offline_form', 'staff', 'automation') and "conversation_inbox_state"."ticket_opened_at" is not null)

staff_drafts_kind_ck.name: staff_drafts_kind_ck
staff_drafts_kind_ck.value: ("staff_drafts"."kind" = 'draft' and "staff_drafts"."client_message_id" is null) or ("staff_drafts"."kind" = 'outgoing' and "staff_drafts"."client_message_id" is not null)

agent_versions_published_ck.name: agent_versions_published_ck
agent_versions_published_ck.value: "agent_versions"."state" = 'draft' or ("agent_versions"."config_hash" is not null and "agent_versions"."published_at" is not null)

kill_switches_target_ck.name: kill_switches_target_ck
kill_switches_target_ck.value:
("kill_switches"."scope" = 'tenant' and "kill_switches"."brand_id" is null and "kill_switches"."agent_id" is null and "kill_switches"."tool_id" is null)
        or ("kill_switches"."scope" = 'brand' and "kill_switches"."brand_id" is not null and "kill_switches"."agent_id" is null and "kill_switches"."tool_id" is null)
        or ("kill_switches"."scope" = 'agent' and "kill_switches"."agent_id" is not null and "kill_switches"."tool_id" is null)
        or ("kill_switches"."scope" = 'tool' and "kill_switches"."tool_id" is not null and "kill_switches"."agent_id" is null)

sso_domains_domain_ck.name: sso_domains_domain_ck
sso_domains_domain_ck.value: "sso_domains"."domain"::text = lower("sso_domains"."domain"::text) and length("sso_domains"."domain"::text) between 3 and 253 and position('.' in "sso_domains"."domain"::text) > 1

visitor_blocks_principal_idx.name: visitor_blocks_principal_idx
visitor_blocks_principal_idx.where: "visitor_blocks"."lifted_at" is null and "visitor_blocks"."principal_id" is not null

visitor_blocks_visitor_idx.name: visitor_blocks_visitor_idx
visitor_blocks_visitor_idx.where: "visitor_blocks"."lifted_at" is null and "visitor_blocks"."visitor_id" is not null

visitor_blocks_subject_idx.name: visitor_blocks_subject_idx
visitor_blocks_subject_idx.where: "visitor_blocks"."lifted_at" is null and "visitor_blocks"."external_subject" is not null

visitor_blocks_target_ck.name: visitor_blocks_target_ck
visitor_blocks_target_ck.value: "visitor_blocks"."principal_id" is not null or "visitor_blocks"."visitor_id" is not null or "visitor_blocks"."external_subject" is not null
